description: Kaplan-Meier survival, two series (SAS-style figure, 850x666 PNG). Hand-labelled by pixel analysis; positions are image pixels, origin top-left, +/- ~1 px.

xAxis.notes: axisLineRow is the bottom frame line, which carries the tick marks (bench/axes label format); the value 0 is not at it. Tick marks point outward below the frame (rows ~457-462). x = 0 is NOT at the left frame edge.

yAxis.notes: axisLineCol is the left frame line, which carries the tick marks (bench/axes label format); the value 0 is not at it. Tick marks point outward left of the frame (cols ~82-89). y = 0 is NOT at the bottom frame edge; labels formatted 0.0-1.0.

pitfalls: The plot is a closed box frame; the frame lines are NOT the axes (x = 0 and y = 0 are inside the frame).

A number-at-risk table (44 16 10 5 2 0 / 59 13 7 3 0) sits INSIDE the frame below y = 0, and its row labels '0' and '1' sit left of the frame next to the '0.0' y label — easy to misread as tick labels.
Title, subtitle, a legend box inside the plot (top right), a series legend and a summary table below the axis can all be mistaken for labels.
Two coloured series (blue, red) with '+' censoring markers on the lines.
